name: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic
summary: At small Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil holds three night elven scouts in crude iron cages. He sends Horde adventurers to Stonetalon Peak for wilderness reagents to brew a grim forest magic.

sections.title: A Bitter Brew
sections.body: Under the Horde's watch, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil practices his craft in Malaka'jin's red-rock defile. When three night elf captives fall into his hands, he chooses a mocking ritual made for his woodland foes instead of ordinary butchery. He sends travelers north into the peaks for thick tree sap, feline whiskers from predatory twilight runners, a shimmering fey dragon scale, and scores of eyes from the local forest coursers.

sections.title: A Taste of Home
sections.body: Jin'Zil's playful manner hides a cruel troll humor. He says the brew will help the imprisoned elves feel at home, though they have no forest to frolic in. But magical fauna and concentrated sap make a volatile, lethal venom. When Jin'Zil releases the concoction in the cave, it chokes the life from the caged captives. Their bodies perish, and their ancestral spirits dissolve into luminous wisps that float into the mountains, leaving empty cages behind.

faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil is a Darkspear troll at Malaka'jin in the southern Stonetalon Mountains. He aids the Horde war effort against the night elves with troll alchemy, voodoo, and interrogation.

faq.q: Why does Jin'Zil want so many courser eyes?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil says fierce forest magic takes an abundance of eyes. Troll witch doctors use strange organic ingredients in their potions, but the absurd number also suits Jin'Zil's eccentric, vindictive nature.

faq.q: What happens to the caged night elves when the quest finishes?
faq.answer: After you bring the reagents, Jin'Zil releases toxic brew through his cave. It poisons the three captives, killing them, and their spirits drift away as wisps.

faq.q: Where are all these reagents found?
aliases: where to find forest magic reagents
faq.answer: You can gather courser eyes and Stonetalon sap around Mirkfallon Lake and the northern highlands. Twilight whiskers and the rare fey dragon scale come from farther north, near Stonetalon Peak, where magical beasts roam.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting night elves in Stonetalon?
aliases: why fight night elves in stonetalon
faq.answer: Horde logging in neighboring Ashenvale has drawn fierce resistance from the Sentinels. The night elves still hold Stonetalon Peak and its sacred groves above Horde outposts such as Malaka'jin.

faq.q: Why do the dying elves turn into wisps?
faq.answer: Wisps are the spirits of dead night elves, bound closely to nature. When they die, their souls take a glowing, arboreal form instead of lingering as ordinary ghosts or shades.

angles.text: As a troll, you know Jin'Zil's grim humor and practical voodoo alchemy as hallmarks of Darkspear witch doctor craft.
As a night elf, you see the execution of captives with twisted woodland materials as one of the Horde's crueler acts in Stonetalon.
As a druid, you see majestic fey drakes, coursers, and ancient forest sap harvested for lethal poison, a grim perversion of nature's balance.
As a member of the Horde, you know securing Malaka'jin means subduing night elf resistance across the range, even through a recluse witch doctor's unorthodox methods.
